title: Displayed Paragraph

illustrates.quote: The adjusted left margin (2 cells to the right of the runover position) for displayed text in exercise material is based on the material to which it applies.

blocks.text: A. Choose the answer that shows the best way to write the italicized part. Write the letter. If a part needs no change, write the letter for "Correct as is."
<u>Tamara did a good job starring in the school play.</u> She was the lead actress. She had to work hard to master the part.

items.text: a. Tamara did a good job. Starring in the school play.
b. Tamara did a good job starring, in the school play.
c. Tamara did a good job. She was starring in the school play.

print.notes: Question 1 has no text of its own, only the four lettered answer choices. The displayed paragraph’s own first sentence is italicized in print (built with `_..._`, Emboss’s nearest available emphasis).
